input.overview: Rocky treats its ten numbered targets as boxing rounds. Hit the currently lit round before the switch-close timer advances it automatically; the correct target scores 10,000 and wins the round, while another numbered target scores 1,000. Rounds 3, 6, and 9 are on the left bank; 1, 4, 7, and 10 are on the top bank; 2, 5, and 8 are on the right. Winning ten rounds lights the central Rocky target for Extra Ball. Two cabinet-button Instant Wins are available per game and carry from ball to ball.
input.simpleOverview: Shoot the numbered target for the currently lit boxing round before the timer advances it. Rounds 3, 6, and 9 are left; 1, 4, 7, and 10 are at the top; 2, 5, and 8 are right. Win ten rounds to light the center Rocky target for Extra Ball.
input.summary: Read the lit round before each controlled flip, then use the five-flipper layout to keep the ball on the side containing that target. If the shot is not aligned, return the ball to the top rather than taking a low-value wrong target.

quickInfo.name: Win a Round
quickInfo.summary: Hit the numbered target matching the lit round.

quickInfo.name: Extra Ball
quickInfo.summary: Win ten rounds, then hit the lit Rocky target.

steps.text: Read the lit round number, then shoot the matching numbered target before the timer advances the round.
Use the left flippers for rounds 3, 6, and 9; use the upper-right route for rounds 1, 4, 7, and 10; use the right flippers for rounds 2, 5, and 8.
If the matching shot is not available, send the ball back to the top and wait for a safer feed instead of taking a wrong numbered target.
After ten round wins, hit the lit central Rocky target to collect Extra Ball.

alternatives.title: Instant Win
alternatives.when: Use this when the active round is difficult and preserving the ball is more valuable than saving the award.

steps.text: Press the green cabinet button to win the current round instantly.
Track the two Instant Wins across balls; unused awards are remembered until the game ends.
Win rounds 2 through 4 for 2x Bonus, rounds 5 through 7 for 5x, and eight or more rounds for 10x.
Continue to ten round wins and collect Extra Ball at the central Rocky target.

machineSetup: Test all ten numbered targets, their round lamps, the switch-close timer, the central Rocky target, all five flippers, bank resets, the top hole, spinner, spot target, and bonus display.
Verify that the green cabinet Instant Win button awards exactly two uses per game and remembers unused awards from ball to ball.

playfieldReferences.label: Top round bank
playfieldReferences.description: Targets for rounds 1, 4, 7, and 10 plus the Rocky award target.

playfieldReferences.label: Central Rocky target
playfieldReferences.description: Target that collects Extra Ball after ten round wins.

playfieldReferences.label: Top hole
playfieldReferences.description: Hole that advances flashing bumpers and other lit awards.

playfieldReferences.label: Instant Win button
playfieldReferences.description: Cabinet control that awards the current round, twice per game.

cautions.issue: The five-flipper layout divides control between the left and right halves.
cautions.response: Do not force a cross-playfield round target from the wrong side; return the ball upward and wait for the appropriate feed.
